purpose: Qualify a conservative M4 scheduler that preserves FIFO service and reward-variance composition while rescuing strictly greater imminent registered opportunity.

development_evidence.corpus: The 20 authenticated OARS confirmatory arms containing 1280 eight-candidate decisions.
development_evidence.exploratory_boundary: The exact policy and thresholds below were chosen after exploratory inspection of this corpus. The canonical replay is a development qualification, not an independent efficacy estimate.

policy.name: m4_rescue
policy.candidate_set: The authenticated eight-group controlled frontier reconstructed from controller-ordered lifecycle events.
feasibility: Retain at least three of the four FIFO groups.
Keep selected valid actor tokens within [0.98, 1.02] times FIFO tokens using the existing ceil/floor integer boundary.
Keep summed group reward variance at least as large as FIFO, allowing only the declared numeric tolerance.
objective_order: choose the lexicographically smallest ordered group-ID tuple
policy.actuation_rule: Enact the best feasible non-FIFO batch only when its imminent-expiry registered L1 exceeds FIFO by more than the declared tolerance; otherwise return FIFO exactly.
policy.imminent_definition: A group is imminent when start_weight_version + max_staleness_versions <= current_learner_version. The historical replay uses max_staleness_versions=1.

requirements.provenance: All 20 archives and their lifecycle, opportunity, and OARS ledgers must authenticate against preserved SHA-256 receipts and reconstruct exactly.
requirements.determinism: Two complete replays must produce byte-identical canonical selection records.

live_qualification.scope: Exactly one 64-update, one-node, two-GPU, controlled-eight-candidate, outcome-excluded actuation qualification.
live_qualification.model_and_workload: The already qualified Llama-1B GSM8K OARS-v2 systems environment.
exclusions: No terminal benchmark or training-quality analysis.
No claim about terminal accuracy, wall-time improvement, queue-trajectory counterfactuals, or causal mediation.
No retry, extension, or quality acquisition is authorized by this protocol.

interpretation_boundary: The offline corpus was used for policy development, so a pass establishes deterministic feasibility and proxy behavior on authenticated historical choice sets, not independent generalization.
The live qualification is a systems and exact-actuation check only.
Any terminal-quality comparison requires a separately preregistered randomized acquisition and new authorization.
